description: This file defines a Java interface 'PackingEvent' which specifies event constants and methods related to packing events within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PackingEvent
classes.description: A Java interface for representing packing-related events within the shipment packing module of OFBiz, including event codes and behaviors.

methods.name: runEvent
methods.description: Executes the packing event within a given session using a specified event code.

methods.name: receiveMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message associated with the packing event.

methods.name: getEventStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the event.

methods.name: getEventCode
methods.description: Returns the code representing the type of event.
